# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## Overview
A real-time digital trading ledger for the Shatranj megagame, supporting 10 teams and 1 Admin over a local Wi-Fi network.

## 1. Authentication
* **Admin:** Accessed at `/admin`. Requires a single admin keyword (from `.env`).
* **Participant:** Accessed at `/` (root). Requires `TeamID` and `Password` (generated by the Admin during onboarding).

* **Dashboard:** Displays current game state with controls: `Start Game`, `Pause Game`, `End Game`, and `Reset Game`. `Reset Game` performs a complete wipe: deletes all onboarded player teams, wipes all player mails, deletes player orders, and re-initializes Admin standing orders to their baseline. Includes `Save Game` button and `Load Game` selector for discrete snapshot management.

* **Backup & Save/Load System (Admin-Exclusive):**
  * **Automated 1-Minute Backup:** Background timer creates atomic snapshots into `saves/backup.json` via a safe temp file swap. Active strictly when the game is running (`gameState === 'RUNNING'`).
  * **Manual Backup:** Admin Sidebar button `<Manual Backup>` triggers immediate update of `backup.json`. Disabled with "Backup Engine Inactive" badge if game is `NOT_STARTED` or `PAUSED`. When game is first started (`RUNNING`), initially shows "No backup taken" until a backup is created, then displays "Last Backup: [timestamp]".
  * **Save Game:** Creates standalone timestamped JSON dumps in `/saves` folder with optional descriptive tags.
  * **Load Game:** Dropdown listing both live `backup.json` and all discrete saved files in `/saves`. Atomically restores all teams, orders, escrows, and mails inside a single transaction, and **strictly initializes into `PAUSED` state** so the Game Master can inspect before resuming trades.
  * **Participant Isolation:** Participants have no visibility or access to backup, save, or load functionalities.






* **Team Onboarding:**
  * File dropzone for a CSV (Team ID, Team Name) or manual text entry.
  * A parser that generates credentials for teams.
  * An empty field to assign each team to one of the 10 Regions via a dropdown.
  * A "Confirm" button (disabled until all regions are assigned) that finalizes onboarding and generates passwords.
* **Disaster Management:**
  * Launch standard or Custom Disasters with targetable regions, flat loss maximum caps (`maxCap`), and percentage modifiers.
* **Card Engine & Round Execution:**
  * Assign standard and Elite cards to teams. View toggle states (built, active) and unilaterally disable cards.
  * A "Log Round" step clock button to execute compound math (deducts sustain costs, adds yields).
  * NAV (Net Asset Value) calculates instantaneously based on current Admin Buy rates.
  * Admin has text-editable fields to manually adjust any team's Food, Material, or Gold.
* **Order Ledger (God Mode):**
  * Admin views all orders (including private/targeted team orders).
  * Full CRUD (Read, Update, Delete) access to any order.
  * Toggle/Edit the permanent "Admin Standing Orders".

## 3. Participant UI (Trading Terminal)
* **HUD (Navbar):**
  * Displays current Food, Material, Gold, and calculated NAV (with icons).
  * Shows tiny floating `+x` or `-x` text to indicate the latest inventory change.
  * Mailbox icon to access order notifications.
* **Cards Infrastructure HUD:**
  * Displays assigned cards with Build, Sustain, and Yield stats.
  * Toggles to build and activate cards.
  * Features a **Next Round Ticker** dynamically calculating exact resource deltas before the next round ticks.
* **Mailbox:**
  * A popup list (also accessible via a dedicated sidebar page) showing completed order messages. Mails can be crossed out/dismissed.
* **Order Validation (Escrow):**
  * System instantly checks team reserves upon order creation. Rejects orders if resources are insufficient.

## 4. The Order Ledger (Main Participant View)
* **Layout & Stickiness:**
  * Top Sticky: Two permanent Admin orders (`Buy from Admin`, `Sell to Admin`).
  * Secondary Sticky: Incoming Private/Targeted orders sent specifically to that team.
  * Main List: Public orders (`<Region> <Buy/Sell> <Amount> <Icon> for <Price>`).
  * Dynamic buttons: `BUY` appears on selling orders, `SELL` appears on buying orders.
* **Filtering & Sorting:**
  * Sort by Price (Highest/Lowest).
  * Filter by Team Name (text search).
  * Filter by Buy or Sell.
  * Filter by Resource (Food or Material).
  * Filter by Visibility (Public, Private, All).
  * Filters must support multi-toggle combinations.
* **Order Creation:**
  * Fixed row at the bottom: "Create new order".
  * Fields: Dropdowns for Buy/Sell and Resource (Food/Material). Editable text labels for Amount and Price.
  * "Confirm" button unlocks only when all fields are populated.

## 5. UI/UX Design Clause & Theming
*   **Aesthetic Identity:** The application must heavily feature the "Empire of the Sun" aesthetic derived from the `/docs` geography. Colors evoke desert sand, parchment, quarried stone, and royal gold (`stone-900`, `parchment`, `gold-500`, `crimson-700`).
*   **Geography Alignment:** The 10 distinct regions (e.g., Theban Floodplains, Red Sea Harbors, Nubian Cataracts) must be used.
*   **Typography & Legibility:** Regal serif fonts (Playfair Display / Georgia) for headers and branding, paired with a highly legible sans-serif for the intense data grids. Despite the thematic overlay, the tables and trading data must be hyper-legible as participants will make snap decisions under extreme time pressure.
*   **The Imperial Citadel:** Admin interfaces should be branded specifically to the ruling Sovereign (The Imperial Citadel) acting as God Mode over the realm, ensuring it is distinct from the Participant UI.
